record.context_brief: When a virtually self-dual weight enumerator comes from an actual self-dual code
record.original_question: Given a virtually self-dual weight enumerator F, determine necessary and sufficient conditions, short of brute-force enumeration, for F to occur as the weight enumerator of some self-dual code C.

evidence.quote: A homogeneous polynomial F(x, y) ... is called a virtual weight enumerator ... Such an F ... is called a virtually self-dual weight enumerator over GF(q).

Open Question 15.2. Given a virtually self-dual weight enumerator F, find necessary and sufficient conditions (short of enumeration) which determine whether or not F arises as the weight enumerator of some self-dual code C.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let q be a prime power and let F(x,y) be a homogeneous polynomial of degree n in two variables with non-negative integer coefficients, written
  F(x,y) = sum_{i=0}^{n} A_i x^{n-i} y^i,
with A_0 = 1. Call F a virtual weight enumerator over GF(q) if its coefficients are non-negative integers and A_0 = 1. Call F a virtually self-dual weight enumerator over GF(q) if, in addition, F is invariant under the MacWilliams transform at q, i.e.
  F(x,y) = q^{-n/2} F(x + (q-1) y,\ x - y).
A linear code C ⊆ GF(q)^n is self-dual if C = C^⊥ with respect to the standard inner product, and its Hamming weight enumerator is W_C(x,y) = sum_{c∈C} x^{n - wt(c)} y^{wt(c)}.

Problem: Find necessary and sufficient conditions, not requiring exhaustive enumeration over codes of length n, that determine whether a given virtually self-dual weight enumerator F(x,y) over GF(q) is realized as the Hamming weight enumerator W_C(x,y) of some self-dual linear code C ⊆ GF(q)^n.
artifact.status_search_result: A web search did not surface any published resolution of this question. The literature provides constructions of self-dual codes with prescribed weight enumerators and various non-existence results (e.g., restrictions on enumerators of singly-even self-dual codes), but no general necessary-and-sufficient criterion, short of enumeration, is known. The problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Some restrictions on weight enumerators of singly even self-dual codes
status_evidence.snippet: Only partial restrictions on weight enumerators of self-dual codes are known.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial necessary conditions are available in the literature, not a complete characterization.

status_evidence.title: Weight enumerators of self-dual codes
status_evidence.snippet: Gleason-type theorems describe the algebra of possible enumerators but do not determine realizability.
status_evidence.claim: Invariant-theoretic descriptions characterize virtually self-dual enumerators but do not settle which arise from actual self-dual codes.
